area: inspection lots, results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications, inspection plans and setup
notes: Business actions for /sc4sap:assist, executed only through ZMCP_BIZ_EXECUTE on the SAP side (handler ZCL_MCP_BIZ_QM).
Queries verified on S/4HANA only; on ECC every QM action stays hidden until it is tested there.

Write actions are built and checked up to the authorization step on S/4HANA, but stay hidden: the test user had no QM write authorization (Q_UD_CODE, Q_QMEL QM01 / QM02, transaction QE11), so no write was executed yet.
A bare notification request is ambiguous: maintenance notifications are PM, quality notifications (TQ80-QMTYP 02) are QM.

BAPI_INSPLOT_SETUSAGEDECISION and BAPI_QUALNOT_CREATE have no test mode: their previews run the handler checks. Results recording previews call the BAPI and roll back; notification status changes preview with a BAPI test run.
Not offered: changing a usage decision (QA12), stock postings after the decision (QAC2 / QA12), inspection lot creation or cancellation, sample management, defects recording, quality certificates.
No person names are returned (creator, inspector, changer).

en: The BAPI has no test mode: the preview checks lot, code, authorization and open characteristics only.
The stock target follows the code proposal; the executed result shows the real posting.
A decision with stock posting cannot be undone here (code change in QA12, stock only by a transfer posting).
ko: BAPI에 테스트 모드가 없어요. 미리보기는 로트, 코드, 권한, 미결 특성만 확인해요.
재고 이동 대상은 코드의 제안을 따라요. 실제 전기 결과는 실행 후에 보여드려요.
재고 전기까지 된 사용결정은 여기서 되돌릴 수 없어요(코드 변경은 QA12, 재고는 이전 전기로만).
